item.title: Saludent Hair Removal Cream Body care Gentle Not Stimulating Painless hair 80g+Aloe Whitening
item.description:
🌸【Buy 1 Take 2】Nykaa Gentle Hair Remover Cream Body care Not Stimulating 80g+Nykaa Aloe Niacinamide Whitening Gel 50g

🌸Product name： Nykaa Hair Remover Cream  80g；Nykaa Aloe Whitening Gel 50g

🌸Specifications： 80g + 50g+50g

🌸Ingredients： CALCIUM THIOGLYCOLATE，GLYCERIN，BISABOLOL，UREA，Niacinamide，4D Hyaluronic acid，Aloe vera

🌸Effects： 

Remover cream：Painless hair removal at home with results that last longer than shaving, unwanted hair can easily removed by a spatula.

🌸Aloe Whitening Gel：Soothes and repairs skin, whitening skin

🌸Skin Types： Suitable for various skin types

How to Use

🌸Step 1: For better result, do some thing for soften your hair, like a hot bath.

🌸Step 2: Put the cream on the area for hair removal and leave the cream on for 7 to 10 minutes.

🌸Step 3: Use the containing spatula to remove hair in the area where you applied the cream.

🌸Step 4: Thoroughly rinse area with lukewarm water(No soap), where cream was applied.

🌸Note: Waiting 24 hours between second time application.

Cautions:

1.🌸If you are pregnant, nursing, or currently taking any medication, consult with a physician prior to use, do not exceed suggested use.

2.🌸Previously test your skin reaction before applying the cream to the area you wish to treat.

3.🌸Keep out of reach of children.

4.🌸Designed for use on legs, arms, underarms & bikini line, but not suitable for use on the face, head, breast, perianal or genital areas or on any other body parts.
